text:
Sam: FYI PR 612: /v1/files generate example shows `file` as object but schema is array. I'm going to pick the canonical shape. @mia can you confirm runtime behaviour? https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/612
Mia: Runtime accepts both single object and array (coercion in API layer). OpenAPI currently only documents array. We should either broaden schema or add an explicit coercion note. I prefer: keep schema as array + docs note + both examples.
Ashley: Agree with a docs note. Runtime coercion is an implementation detail; keeping schema strict avoids surprising validators. For JS SDK we already wrap singletons. I'll update the JS snippet and add a small helper.
Sam: Proposal: keep schema as array, add two examples (recommended array + single-item quick example) and a short sentence: "server will coerce single object -> array". Also add migration blurb for strict validators.
Ryan: Heads up for Python SDK folks: current examples use `files=[...]`. If we add single-file example, include helper `def ensure_list(x): return x if isinstance(x, list) else [x]` so users copy/paste cleanly.
docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy.preview.redwood/inference/612 (build passed)
Mia: Pushed docs commit updating OpenAPI examples, adding the coercion note and both samples. Link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/612#discussion_r. Leaving a TODO to sync the snippet in `sdk-js/examples/upload-file.md`.
Ashley: Tiny nit in JS snippet: prefer `const ensureFiles = f => Array.isArray(f) ? f : [f]; // normalize input` over inline ternary in sample. I'll add the commit.
Sam: :thumbsup: LGTM. Merge once CI is green. Please add a one-line changelog entry for the user-facing note (customers with strict schema validators).
Ryan: Added changelog entry at docs/changelog.md in the PR branch.
docs-bot: PR merged by sam.lewis — 1 file changed. Deploying to prod.
